gripOrHq.title: Galatea
gripOrHq.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Galatea, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

gripOrHq.title: Project Zurich
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Sandstorm
gripOrHq.rulesText: Sandstorm has one "*End the run" subroutine for every [2] you pay, above the rez cost, when you rez it.

gripOrHq.title: Lesley Major
gripOrHq.rulesText: Install Lesley Major only in a subsidiary data fort. [5]: Add two advancement counters, at no cost, to a card installed in this data fort. Use this ability only when Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort, and only once per run.

gripOrHq.title: Gatekeeper
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gatekeeper has one "*End the run" subroutine for every [2] you pay, above the rez cost, when you rez it.

heapOrArchives.title: Emergency Rig
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

heapOrArchives.title: Caryatid
heapOrArchives.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Caryatid, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-to-Own Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put on that ice a number of Term counters equal to its rez cost. At the start of each of your turns, if you have at least [2], lose [2] and remove one of these Term counters; otherwise, put a Term counter on that piece of ice.

discardCards.title: Nomad Allies
discardCards.rulesText:
A, [1]: Remove a tag, at no cost.
[T]: Avoid receiving a tag.

scoreArea.title: Charity Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [9] and 1 Bad Publicity point. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

scoreArea.title: Please Don't Choke Anyone
scoreArea.rulesText: For each 1 damage you successfully do, you may choose instead to prevent that damage and put a PDCA counter on Please Don't Choke Anyone. PDCA counter: Gain an action. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

rig.title: Highlighter
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Bug Zapper
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

ice.title: Galatea

ice.title: Walking Wall
ice.rulesText: *End the run. [1]: Move Walking Wall and insert it in a different position on this data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run on this data fort. You may use this ability even if Walking Wall is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.
